name: Keiren ~Konna Kawaii Ko ga Toro Kao Keiren Suru Nante~
original_name: けいれん～こんな可愛い子がトロ顔痙攣するなんて～
source:
Both Himeko, the girl next door, and Hiori, the tsundere classmate, have something in common... They’re both so sensitive that they end up convulsing!

Kiyota Sanobe is in his second year at Midoumori School and lives by himself.
One day... he ends up accidentally double-booking himself!

The first date is with his neighbor, Himeko Shiina, who he meets on the way to school every morning.
She happened to receive two tickets from her friend, so she invited him to go out with her.

The second date is with his nitpicking classmate, Hiori Hanezaki. As thanks for sharing his lunch with her, she half-forced him into a promise to go shopping together.

Whichever date Kiyota ends up going on will ultimately turn into a romantic relationship, but no matter which girl he chooses, one thing’s for certain... Yep, both of these girls are so sensitive that they’ll end up convulsing!

[From [url=https://www.johren.games/games/download/keirenkonnakawaiikogatoroga-ja/]Johren[/url]]
translation:
邻家女孩姬子和傲娇同学日织都有一个共同点……都敏感到抽搐！

佐野清太在御堂森学校读二年级，独自生活。
有一天……他不小心重复预订了自己！

第一次约会是和他的邻居椎名姬子，他每天早上在上学的路上遇到她。
她碰巧收到朋友寄来的两张门票，于是邀请他一起出去。

第二次约会是和他挑剔的同学羽崎希织。为了感谢他和她一起吃午饭，她半强迫他答应一起去逛街。

无论清太最终进行哪一次约会，最终都会变成恋爱关系，但无论他选择哪个女孩，有一点是确定的……是的，这两个女孩都太敏感了，最后都会抽搐！
